Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: In Step 6, the Planner misinterpreted the information found on the Wikipedia page. The visible text clearly states: "The conference was known as the Eastern College Athletic Conference-North from 1979 to 1988 and the North Atlantic Conference from 1988 to 1996." The Planner correctly identified the years and the name "North Atlantic Conference" in the analysis section but then erroneously concluded in the "Updated Understanding" that the name was "ECAC North" (or ECAC-North) for the 1988–1996 period. ECAC North was the name used from 1979 to 1988, not 1988 to 1996. This contradiction between the source text and the Planner's final conclusion led to the incorrect answer.
